input.task: Sort the catalogue by price, low to high, and name the cheapest product.

provenance: the mirror image of l4-shop-button-text-renamed, and the reason the relocation ladder needs two rungs rather than one. Here the plan targets the sort control by ROLE+ACCESSIBLE NAME using the visible copy ('Cheapest first'); under button-text-renamed the accessible name is the old string held in aria-label, so tier 1 finds nothing while the visible text matches exactly. Recovery must therefore go role+name -> text, the opposite direction from the sibling case. Without both rungs one of the two cases is always red.
